rules.statement: A judgment creditor must be able to take complete and effectual possession of immovable property as required by Section 325 of the Civil Procedure Code, even if the interval between delivery of possession and disturbance is short.
rules.supporting_quote: "In such a case the shortness of the interval between the delivery of possession and the disturbance of possession is important. A PPEAL from a judgment of the District Court, Badulla."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 325 of the Civil Procedure Code
